description:
Use this when the user asks about sealed product prices in one game: booster
    boxes, elite trainer boxes, bundles, packs, tins and cases. Returns today's market
    price (USD) and 30-day percent change per product, most expensive first. For one
    named product, search_cards plus card_price is more direct.
